title: Treatment Evaluation at the Intensive and Extensive Margins
abstract: arXiv:2412.11179v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper provides a solution to the evaluation of treatment effects in selective samples when neither instruments nor parametric assumptions are available. We provide sharp bounds for average treatment effects under a conditional monotonicity assumption for all principal strata, i.e. units characterizing the complete intensive and extensive margins. Most importantly, we allow for a large share of units whose selection is indifferent to treatment, e.g. due to non-compliance. The existence of such a population is crucially tied to the regularity of sharp population bounds and thus conventional asymptotic inference for methods such as Lee bounds can be misleading. This problem can be solved using smoothed outer identification regions for inference. We provide semiparametrically efficient debiased machine learning estimators for both regular and smooth bounds that can accommodate high-dimensional covariates and flexible functional form

translated_title: 集约边际与广延边际上的处理效应评估
translated_abstract: 本文为在既无工具变量又无参数假设可用时，选择性样本中处理效应的评估问题提供了解决方案。我们在所有主要分层的条件单调性假设下，为平均处理效应提供了尖锐界，其中主要分层是指刻画完整集约边际和广延边际的单位。最重要的是，我们允许存在大量其选择与处理无关的单位，例如由不依从行为导致的单位。这类群体的存在与尖锐总体界的正则性密切相关，因此诸如Lee界等方法的常规渐近推断可能产生误导。该问题可以通过使用平滑的外部识别区域进行推断来解决。我们为正则界和平滑界均提供了半参数有效的去偏机器学习估计量，这些估计量可以容纳高维协变量和灵活的函数形式。
tldr: 本文在无工具变量和参数假设的条件下，基于条件单调性假设为涵盖集约与广延边际的所有主要分层的平均处理效应构建尖锐界，并针对该群体存在导致的推断正则性问题，提出了半参数有效的去偏机器学习估计量以支持高维协变量下的可靠推断。
en_tdlr: This paper provides sharp bounds for average treatment effects across all principal strata covering intensive and extensive margins under conditional monotonicity without instruments or parametric assumptions, and develops semiparametrically efficient debiased machine learning estimators to address the irregular inference issues arising from the presence of indifferent units.
